facts.fact: DHIS2, the developer, says the SEMIS app is being piloted in The Gambia, with South Sudan and Eswatini, the pilots to move to a next phase in early 2025; no number of schools is given, and the page is undated, so its published date is used.

systems.tiers: school staff enrol learners, take attendance and record promotion, transfer and assessment data, as the product is described

note: The description of what staff enter is of the product in general, not of its use in The Gambia; only the pilot is stated of this country.
